Game Overview

Bread Pit 2 puts players into a clicker experience centered on help Bread Pit navigate 25 clever levels, using quirky contraptions to toast perfection. Collect cheese for extra challenges as you skillfully time your jumps in this delightful puzzle adventure. Simple yet addictive, keep returning to master the art of bread-to-toaster transitions.
